name: DPA
description: 9,10-Diphenylanthracene. Blue emitter used with 4CzTPN-Ph, MR-1, BTZ-DMAC(-4Br), DMACPDO, DCF-MPYM.

name: Perylene
description: Blue emitter with DCF-MPYM (635 nm excitation) and BNS (721 nm, ηUC 3.0%).

name: TTBP
description: 2,5,8,11-Tetra-tert-butylperylene, T1 1.53 eV, ΦFL 94.8%. NIR→blue with S2. Ref 56.

name: TIPS-BEA
description: 9,10-Bis[(triisopropylsilyl)ethynyl]anthracene. With BNS: 721 nm → 451 nm, ηUC 5.8%.

name: DBP (2,7-di-tBu-pyrene)
description: T1 2.5 eV, S1 3.3 eV. The emitter tethered to 4CzPN in the DBP conjugates. Ref 57.

name: 1,4-TIPS-Naph
description: 1,4-Bis(TIPS-ethynyl)naphthalene, T1 2.11 eV. Best UV emitter here: ηUC 26.2% with 4CzBN, 21.4% with BN-Se.

name: 1,5-TIPS-Naph
description: 1,5-Bis(TIPS-ethynyl)naphthalene, T1 2.24 eV. With BN-2Cz-tBu (ηUC 2.5%). Ref 44.

name: 1-TNA
description: 1-(TIPS-ethynyl)naphthalene, T1 2.40 eV. With BN-Se: 0.93 eV anti-Stokes shift. Ref 62.

name: p-Terphenyl (TP)
description: UV emitter (343 nm) with 4CzIPN: ηUC 2.8%, ΔE 0.83 eV. Ref 58.

name: p-Quaterphenyl
description: Emits at 353 nm with 4CzIPN (ηUC 3.9%). Ref 58.

name: R/S-TP (chiral terphenyl dimer)
description: Two p-terphenyls stacked on a [2.2]paracyclophane. With 4CzIPN: circularly polarized UV upconversion at 385 nm, ηUC 7.9%. Ref 61.

name: DPN
description: 1,4-Diphenylnaphthalene. Emitter and host for all-solid-state UC with BBCz-SB-Br. Ref 68.

name: SiDPN-1
description: DPN with a triphenylsilyl group: amorphous glassy film, UC lifetime 2.8 ms. Ref 68.

name: SiDPN-2
description: Two DPN units on one silicon; Ith 44 mW cm⁻² in the solid state. Ref 68.

name: p-TIPS-BP
description: 4-(TIPS-ethynyl)biphenyl, S1 4.04 eV. 447 nm → 328 nm with 4CzIPN, ΔE 1.01 eV. Ref 64.

name: bTIPS-Bz
description: 1,4-Bis(TIPS-ethynyl)benzene, S1 4.15 eV. First purely organic visible→UVB UC (318 nm); drives a Norrish type I reaction. Ref 66.

name: TIPS-Bz
description: (Phenylethynyl)triisopropylsilane, S1 4.43 eV. UVC emitter (~295 nm) with Hep. Ref 69.

name: Bu-TIPS-Bz
description: 4-tert-Butyl TIPS-Bz; triplet lifetime 14.5 µs. Ref 69.

name: bBu-TIPS-Bz
description: 3,5-Di-tert-butyl TIPS-Bz: bulk suppresses triplet excimers (τT 29.5 µs); best of the series. Ref 69.

name: PPD
description: 2,5-Diphenyl-1,3,4-oxadiazole; UV emitter screened with 4CzBN. Ref 63.

name: PPO
description: 2,5-Diphenyloxazole (scintillator); ηUC ~14% with 4CzBN. Ref 63.

name: PPF
description: 2,5-Diphenylfuran; UV emitter screened with 4CzBN. Ref 63.

name: 2PI
description: 2-Phenylindene; UV emitter screened with 4CzBN. Ref 63.
